name: plate-56-detent-v18
version_tag: #170 DETENT v18, 8 OBJECTS — Ron's spec, verbatim: 'give me the tabs, press fit detent disc and a short nose that completely engages for no play in the day jump' + 'the roller that fits in between the teeth seems like a perfect detent.' Package: 175 deep-V disc (31 teeth, depth 2.6 vs ring's 1.4; press bore r11.96 FRICTION-FITS the #164 hub flange r12 — holds through every escape, a deliberate two-hand twist re-clocks it: adjustable clocking, Ron's requirement), 176 roller bridge springs soft/med/firm (v17 tabs and leaf unchanged -> drop into the r65 pockets; the flexy 13mm finger replaced by a rigid gusset + short stub carrying a FREE ROLLER dia 4.6 that seats two-flank in the V: zero tangential play, rolling escape, no stick-slip), 177 roller x3 (one + spares; the BOARD is the keeper: roller top 4.8 under board 5.0 — cannot climb out in service, lifts off for inspection). Ring 164 and v17 springs retire; board sockets go unused (harmless). 39 gates PASS incl. both-bridge fwd/rev lift-curve identity at the new depth, July 4.63 rejection, r65 pocket installability all six cases, stub free-end exception carried by numbers (0.83MPa, 1.2um), press-vs-escape torque. Assembly: press disc onto hub flange, springs into pockets (SOFT first), drop rollers onto stubs, board on. Set clocking: board to a date, twist disc so rollers seat, verify next-day click centres. | QUIET.
